objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and manage a patient presenting with epigastric discomfort and cramping pain.

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

“Hi doctor—I've been having epigastric discomfort with cramping pain for the last two hours. It’s similar to past episodes and it usually happens after I eat, so I’ve started avoiding meals and I’ve had some unintentional weight loss. I also smoke and have only occasional alcohol.”

“Not that I know for sure, doctor—I've had this epigastric cramping discomfort mostly after meals, and during these episodes I’ve avoided eating and lost some weight, but I haven’t noticed nausea, vomiting, or any changes in my bowel habits.”
